capture.source: live #jgbox from each Demonstration metadata route
capture.scene: fresh browser context with empty local/session storage; exact route without query; route default preset; capture-only board resize, axes/grid visibility, preview legibility treatment, and bounding box; graph state and geometry unchanged
capture.coordinateContextPolicy: per capture: retain axes, ticks, and grid for basics and function families; hide them for other families
capture.scalePolicy: equal user-unit scale to preserve geometric proportions
capture.typography: capture-only 12px JSXGraph text and rational smart-label font with 1.2 line-height; source content unchanged
capture.strokeTreatment: capture-only curve strokes scaled 1.12× and construction strokes scaled 1.16× with modest opacity lift; source content unchanged
capture.containment: finite construction objects and their text annotations stay within the board; axis/tick labels are context; unbounded coordinate-route curves are viewport-clipped by JSXGraph
capture.boundsPolicy: finite visible objects and point coordinates; excludes axes, ticks, and grid; up to three text-aware refits; coordinate-route curves may extend beyond the viewport
